freezing.source: The anchor of icheme:crystal_carbon_dioxide_i (revision crystal-carbon_dioxide-i-r2), its values and estimated flag. CO2 sublimes at 1 atm (194.7 K) and has no normal melting point: normal_melting_kelvin holds the triple point. The fusion enthalpy is the crystal's effective value, chosen for the pilot family (ChemSep's own heat of fusion is the same 9019 J/mol; its triple point 216.58 K, 518672 Pa). Data only: never a validity floor or a range end.
